title: Goa Lottory Apparatus
detailed_description: Goa Lottory Apparatus. Formerly displayed in Museum. At present it is kept in the reserve collection. The provedoria da Assistance publica now known as Institute of public Assistant was formed in the year 1947 by Ex-Portuguese Government in order to co-ordinate and exercise supervision all over the modalities to derive its income from profits made out of the sale of lotteries among other sources. .
